title: Professor Dilli Dogo is a highly esteemed figure in the field of surgery and medicine, known for his exceptional academic achievements and contributions to healthcare. His journey began in primary school, where he showcased remarkable talent, leading to numerous accolades throughout his education, including the Best Students Award in secondary school. He graduated in medicine with distinction from the University of Maiduguri in 1984 and completed his residency at the University College Hospital, Ibadan. Over the years, he has excelled in various professional examinations and has held significant positions, including Reader in Surgery at the University of Maiduguri. Professor Dogo is actively involved in numerous professional bodies and has received multiple awards for his contributions to medicine. He has published over 32 works and participated in international conferences. Outside of his professional life, he enjoys swimming, reading, and philanthropy, and is a devoted family man with five children.
